thread:
sam: Opening a small docs PR to make the Quickrun truly frictionless for first-timers. Goals: 3 steps, no global installs, consistent env var names, and a tiny docker-compose local path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2401
rohan: Love it. Can you paste the auth snippet here so I can check SDK parity? We keep getting reports of people using REDWOOD_TOKEN vs REDWOOD_API_KEY.
sam: Sure — current snippet in the branch (will switch to .env):
```bash
# .env.example
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REPLACE_ME
REDWOOD_DEFAULT_MODEL=hello-mini
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"input":"hey"}'
liz: Small nit: fenced block should include language for our linter (```bash). Also add a short comment about trial keys expiring in 24h and never check them into git.
rohan: Agree. Also confirm the SDK helpers use REDWOOD_API_KEY — keep that canonical across docs and code snippets.
sam: Yep changed everywhere in the branch. Also replaced long `docker run -e` list with `--env-file .env` and added a docker-compose dev service so people can try offline without registering (it mocks a minimal /health + generation route).
liz: CI (link-check) failed for the TOC anchor — unrelated to your change but will block merge. CI bot: @ci-bot any idea?
ci-bot: docs build: failed — 1 broken link: /getting-started/quick-start -> 404 (redirect mis-match).
eve: I can take the Netlify redirect issue. Looks like we have both quickstart and quick-start aliases; consolidating to /getting-started/quickstart and adding a permanent redirect should fix it. I'll push a tiny netlify.toml tweak.
sam: Thanks! Once CI is green can someone backport to stable-1.0? Want this in next week's onboarding sweep.
rohan: I can backport and scan Dedicated docs for any REDWOOD_API_KEY collisions.
liz: Quick doc test idea: add a smoke step in the e2e that runs docker-compose up, curls /health and ensures 200. That'll catch regressions.
sam: Done in branch — added `tests/quickstart_smoke.sh` and `.github/workflows/docs-smoke.yml` step. Also clarified the "no-account local" flow: 1) copy .env.example, 2) docker-compose up, 3) curl localhost:8080/generate.
eve: pushed the Netlify fix and restarted the build.
ci-bot: docs build: success — all checks passed.
rohan: Reviewed and merged. Backported to stable-1.0 in PR #2402.
liz: Thanks — I'll update the onboarding checklist to point new sign-ups to the slim Quickrun. :tada:
sam: Appreciate the rapid reviews y'all. Will drop a short changelog blurb in the onboarding release notes.
